scene_logic.composition: A dynamic close-up of a museum preparator at a laboratory workbench.
scene_logic.character_main: DINO_BONES_PREPARATOR_6 (Asian female, long black hair) with an expression of intense discovery.
scene_logic.action: Using a precision air-scribe to delicately remove iron-rich matrix from the wing-finger bone of a Pterosaur fossil.
scene_logic.background: A museum prep lab inspired by the SANTANA_ROMUALDO formation; scattered calcareous concretions and technical diagrams of flight membranes are visible in the soft-focus background.

typography.style: 3D thick, rounded bubble letters with a subtle aerodynamic slant.

technical_parameters.lighting: STUDIO_SOFT; clean laboratory lighting with ambient occlusion to highlight the 3D volume of the fossil.
technical_parameters.surface_finish: High-fidelity 3D; tactile 'pebbly' bone texture; character wearing a yellow unicorn tee UNDER a white lab coat.
technical_parameters.negative_prompt: realistic, scary, grit, outdoor excavation, 90s CGI, grainy, blurry text, low resolution.
